style.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. Detail pools at silhouettes and landmarks while the ground dissolves into airy open washes. White-paper reserves keep effects and routes distinct. Mood is melancholy, fragile and contemplative; avoid opaque gouache, heavy outlines and smooth computer-rendered volume.

STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. ACTION: Draw an overhead tactical action-RPG fight on a broad sandy Roman arena floor, with small foreshortened combatants seen from above, open paths between them, and a thin rim of stone wall at the screen edges. At lower centre a Water mage faces straight UP the screen with both hands reaching toward enemies: immediately ABOVE her head is an inverted-U cyan magical shield arc, opening DOWN toward her, protecting her front while the sand BELOW and BEHIND her is completely bare. An orange fireball from the enemy mage at upper right bursts into a compact white spark on the TOP edge of this cyan shield arc; separately, a thin cyan needle from the player's outstretched hand travels diagonally toward a shield-bearing soldier at upper left. A slinger farther left and a cinder hound to the right create spaced threats, with a small jagged red-and-black warning patch off to the right; each fighter is small within the broad overhead floor, and every effect has its own clearly readable path. All figures, spell marks and terrain are hand-painted parts of this single game-view illustration; leave quiet strips along the top and bottom for later interface labels.

CONSTRAINTS: An original Roman-era elemental-mage prison game, drawn digitally by hand as a complete two-dimensional illustration. Roman-inspired tunics, sandals, limewashed masonry, terracotta, bronze collars and ward stones; invented people and symbols only. Entire scene in focus, clear silhouettes, readable at a reduced game-screen scale. No three-dimensional rendering, photography, modern equipment, existing franchise designs, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panel grid or decorative outer frame.
